observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor paved street or sidewalk and park areas, residential neighborhoods
observation.dancers: one solo male dancer appearing in different locations
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer moving in place and traveling slightly on paved ground
observation.posture: upright torso with soft, slightly bent knees and relaxed weight distribution
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping, heel-to-toe rolls, quick slides, and rapid foot crossing; exact weight transfers cannot be seen clearly due to video quality
observation.arms_and_hands: arms swinging naturally or held loosely by the sides, sometimes gesturing or crossing in front of the torso
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement with slight bounces and natural body shifts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low to medium levels, occasional small hops, swift turns on the spot
observation.costume_and_props: striped t-shirts, dark or purple trousers, sneakers, caps, and occasionally riding a scooter
observation.cannot_infer: low resolution and rapid camera cuts obscure exact weight placement and subtle foot articulation

signature_moments.what: rapid alternating heel digs and cross-stepping on the pavement
stepping off a scooter into rapid foot shuffling in place
fast sliding and shuffling footwork pattern moving side to side
sudden drop into a low crouch followed by springing back up
